title: The Three Billy Goats Gruff
author: Traditional (Norwegian)
source: Public domain. Retold from the Norwegian tale collected by Asbjørnsen and Moe.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: Once upon a time there were three billy goats named Gruff — a little one, a middle-sized one, and a great big one. On the far side of the river was a hillside of sweet green grass, but to reach it they had to cross a bridge. And under that bridge lived a grumpy old troll.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: First came the little billy goat. Trip-trap, trip-trap, went the bridge.

segments.speaker: troll
segments.text: "WHO'S THAT trip-trapping over MY bridge?"

segments.speaker: little-goat
segments.text: "It is only I, the littlest Billy Goat Gruff, going up the hillside to eat the sweet green grass."

segments.speaker: troll
segments.text: "Then I'm coming up to GOBBLE YOU UP!"

segments.speaker: little-goat
segments.text: "Oh no, please don't take me! I'm far too little. Wait for my brother — he's much bigger than I am."

segments.speaker: troll
segments.text: "Hmph. Very well. Be off with you!"

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: And the little goat trip-trapped safely across.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: Next came the middle-sized billy goat. TRIP-TRAP, TRIP-TRAP, went the bridge, a little louder.

segments.speaker: troll
segments.text: "WHO'S THAT trip-trapping over MY bridge?"

segments.speaker: middle-goat
segments.text: "It is I, the middle Billy Goat Gruff, going up the hillside to eat the sweet green grass."

segments.speaker: troll
segments.text: "Then I'm coming up to GOBBLE YOU UP!"

segments.speaker: middle-goat
segments.text: "Oh, don't bother with me! Wait for my big brother. He is the biggest billy goat you ever did see."

segments.speaker: troll
segments.text: "Hmph! Very well. Be off with you!"

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: And the middle goat trip-trapped safely across.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: Last of all came the great big billy goat. TRIP-TRAP! TRIP-TRAP! The bridge creaked and groaned beneath him.

segments.speaker: troll
segments.text: "WHO'S THAT tramping over MY bridge?!"

segments.speaker: big-goat
segments.text: "IT IS I! THE BIG BILLY GOAT GRUFF!"

segments.speaker: troll
segments.text: "Then I'm coming up to GOBBLE YOU UP!"

segments.speaker: big-goat
segments.text: "Well, come along! I have two big horns and four hard hooves, and we shall see about that!"

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: Up climbed the troll — and the big billy goat lowered his horns and BUTTED him clean off the bridge. SPLASH! The troll flew into the river and floated away downstream, grumbling all the way, and he never bothered anyone's bridge again.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: Then the big billy goat trotted up the hillside to join his brothers, and the three of them ate the sweet green grass until they were so fat they could hardly walk home. And if the grass hasn't run out, they are eating there still. Snip, snap, snout — this tale's told out!
